checks: The finite normalization X over fixed Y0 carries the cover automorphisms. A curve is point-mapped to Y0 exactly when exceptional over X, because X->Y0 is finite. The specified relative-minimal model is therefore the minimal resolution of X, with exactly the existing quantitative budgets.

Shortest common point-blowup resolution plus universal contraction and negative definiteness prove uniqueness of the minimal resolution. Hence every automorphism lifts uniquely and the group law holds without averaging. No equivariant blowup enlarges the resolution size.

The pullback Cartier divisor C and actual canonical-sheaf Jacobian divisor R_g are invariant; consequently Z=alpha C-beta R_g is invariant. Every fixed multiple and retained generating cycle is preserved by the deck action.

For prescribed field character of image order d, the field cover has total degree td and the existing exact skew category uses T=tau* F_(p^nu)* with nu=f/d. Its d-fold composite defines the ordinary q-unit structure. The proof does not impose an incorrect order-d relation on a chosen fundamental-group lift.

The new twisted scalar lemma bounds determinant crossed characters on H by q^(O(t)) before passing to the field cover. Their restrictions fix the ordinary punctured determinants on that cover. Scalar coboundaries restrict trivially to ker chi.

Canonical intermediate bundles have regular forward arrows and inverse poles pC, including the last tau-twisted source. Pairing its determinant with invariant C closes the same cyclic recurrence; all multidegrees are nonnegative with total O(td r).

Discrete determinant extensions are unique from punctured determinant plus exceptional multidegrees. The number of nu phase tuples is q^(O(t)) exp(O(nu td log(r+1)))=q^(O(t)) exp(O(ft log(r+1))). No degree-td ordinary-character list is used.

Fixed generated quotient charts on LC have O(td r^2) coordinates per phase. In the last source, deck pullback changes only fixed reference lines and sections; the tuple coefficients have only their one p-th power. No equivariant cohomology bases or group-order division is needed.

The exact all-ring finite-Hom construction and boundary witnesses retain bounded degree and O(td r^2) size per phase. Products and both Cartier inverse identities have the correct twists. Multiplying by nu gives O(ft r^2), with no expanded d-fold polynomial composite.

Closing a qualitative affine cover under tau costs no parameter coordinates. The last transition correction permutes its indices and applies tau* Frobenius, preserving C-adic order; the recurrence j->pj-p still contracts. Unique fixed jets prove actual gluing, inverses and base-change-compatible formal effectivity.

The lower NC marking retains the quotient and determinant on Z, so the already checked weak-cycle argument supplies actual generated fixed-determinant families. Algebraization is limited to the Noetherian completed tensor bases.

Target Hartogs, determinant units and adjugates give the same nilpotence-independent meromorphic comparison bound. The skew finite-Hom correction has the same depth loss. Iterating only for the finite-etale frame interpretation gives a unique nilpotent isomorphism lift, and uniqueness enforces its skew/deck compatibility.

Finite presentation and the Artinian lifting criterion give clopen represented classes. Every original semilinear representation occurs via its genuine formal transitions and choice independence, not only its finite truncation.

The component prefactor (M+1) is explicitly retained, and the determinant tuple cost is absorbed into q^(A_R^sl t r^2). The statement permits p|d and d=1, but keeps the field character fixed and does not infer projective or gerbe counts.
